envelope.description: Pin the script's grammar to the chat page's

body.title: Pin the script's grammar to the chat page's
body.summary: Add a contract test that reads the chat page's CREF_EXT and CREF_CORE from vscode-plugin/src/chat/link-markup.ts and checks that the page script's grammar equals them except for the directory group, which the script requires to be non-empty.
acceptanceChecks: The test fails when the page script's extension list or line forms differ from the chat page's
The only allowed difference is the required directory part, and the test says so

tests.name: src/docgen/__tests__/code-ref-grammar-pin.test.ts: the page script's reference grammar equals the chat page's CREF_EXT and CREF_CORE except that it requires a directory part
